PURPOSE.what_this_artifact_is: A structure derivation. It reads N07's exact act and exit_condition, reads EVIDENCE_MATERIALIZATION's REQUIRED_CONTENTS and MUST_NEVER_CONTAIN, reads the ten section names the lane mandate requires kept separate, and produces a JSON Schema plus a schema-validating template instance that together ARE the N07 deliverable.
what_this_artifact_is_NOT: It is NOT an execution of any DAG node past N07. N08 (planned witness intake), N09 (VALID UNTIL computation), N10 (HC-1) and every node after it are untouched.
It is NOT an amendment of the DAG authority, its v1.0.1 amendment, the capability package, or the owner-ratification record. All remain byte-identical; see FRESHNESS_RE_DERIVATION.

It is NOT a declaration that DAG node N07 is CLOSED. Per the DAG's own MR1_REACHABILITY_DERIVATION-style discipline and 'node 2 cannot be performed by the lane that wrote node 1', this artifact offers itself as N07's candidate discharge; whether it is SUFFICIENT is for the independent certification this artifact's next_gate names, and formal closure of N07 in the DAG package's own node-status ledger is a separate, later, append-only act this lane does not perform.

It is NOT the custody inventory (N06), the WCM readiness demonstration (N05), the planned witness intake (N08), or the VALID UNTIL computation (N09). Each remains a distinct open node, listed as still-blocking in the DAG's own v1.0.1 amendment (DOWNSTREAM_REACHABILITY_RECOMPUTATION.still_open).
It is NOT the POPULATED evidence artifact. It is the reusable, unpopulated skeleton a future execution lane instantiates and fills.

SECTION_ORDERING_DERIVATION.rule: The lane mandate lists ten concepts to keep separate: PRESTATE, HC-1, VALID UNTIL computation, MR-2, post-MR2 verification, conditional MR-3, post-MR3 verification, credential-delivery confirmation, PRECHECK-R2, final rotation/cleanup. Read as a literal word order, this places PRESTATE before HC-1 and HC-1 before VALID UNTIL, which the DAG's own precondition graph contradicts: N09 (VALID UNTIL) is a precondition of N10 (HC-1) — HC1-S4 is the VALID UNTIL value shown DURING HC-1 — and N14 (the node literally named PHASE P1 PRESTATE OBSERVATION) has precondition N13, which has precondition N11 (MR-2). PRESTATE, in the DAG's own vocabulary, is prestate for the P2 remediation decision, measured AFTER the credential that makes the session possible, not before it.
SECTION_ORDERING_DERIVATION.the_derived_resolution: This artifact orders the ten mandated sections by DAG precondition order, not by the mandate's list order: VALID_UNTIL_COMPUTATION (N08, N09), HC_1 (N10), MR_2 (N11), POST_MR2_VERIFICATION (N12, N13), PRESTATE (N14), MR_3_CONDITIONAL (N15..N20), POST_MR3_VERIFICATION (N21, N22), CREDENTIAL_DELIVERY_CONFIRMATION (N23, N24), PRECHECK_R2 (N26, N27, the two freshness loops), FINAL_ROTATION_CLEANUP (N28). All ten names from the mandate are present, byte-identical in spirit, as section keys; none is renamed, merged or dropped.
SECTION_ORDERING_DERIVATION.why_this_is_a_derivation_and_not_a_subst: The mandate's own sentence says 'It must separate' the ten, not 'it must present them in this order.' Ordering by DAG precondition is the reading that keeps every section internally coherent with the DAG text it cites, rather than forcing PRESTATE to mean something the DAG nowhere means by that word.
SECTION_ORDERING_DERIVATION.flagged: OF-N07-1, so a certifier may reject this ordering and require the mandate's literal word order instead. Rejecting it does not change which fields exist, only where they sit.

FIELD_ALLOCATION_TABLE.rule: Every one of the 15 REQUIRED_CONTENTS items, plus the two register/log fields EVIDENCE_MATERIALIZATION names as ongoing rather than per-phase, is allocated to exactly one home in the schema. No item is duplicated as a hole in two places; where a fact is genuinely measured twice by the DAG for different purposes (e.g. current_user/session_user at both MR-2's own poststate and KP-1), both occurrences are named explicitly so neither is mistaken for the other.

N22 is the closing verification of the whole P2 remediation phase, and MR-3 is the LAST mutation P2 can perform; housing N22's full table at the end of the MR-2/MR-3 arc, immediately before delivery, matches both the DAG's own edge order (N21->N22->N23) and the mandate's own placement of 'post-MR3 verification' immediately before 'credential-delivery confirmation'.

DISPOSITION_STATE_MODEL.rule: Per the lane mandate: 'Unknown/unexecuted fields must have explicit NOT_EXECUTED / UNKNOWN states, never blanks interpreted as PASS.' Every leaf in the companion schema is typed to make a blank, a null, or an omitted key a SCHEMA VIOLATION rather than a silently-accepted default.

the_two_holes_are_distinct_and_not_inter.NOT_EXECUTED: The act that would produce this fact has not yet occurred. It is expected to resolve once its DAG node runs. Used for the template's default state throughout.
the_two_holes_are_distinct_and_not_inter.UNKNOWN: The fact is not, or may not be, measurable at all from the identity this lane may hold — the same sense EVIDENCE_MATERIALIZATION and HOSTED_STATE_UNKNOWN_REGISTER use it in. Used as the template's default for the 13 HU register entries (their own rule: 'Each entry is UNKNOWN and stays UNKNOWN' until a specific measurement resolves it, RULE_FAIL_CLOSED_ON_UNKNOWN governing what happens when it cannot) and for MR-2's own prestate (rolpassword existence, declared UNKNOWN per E-9, never guessed).

DISPOSITION_STATE_MODEL.additionalProperties_false_everywhere: Enforced at every object level in the schema. A field this authority did not anticipate cannot be added to a populated instance without failing schema validation, which is the intended effect: an unanticipated field in an evidence document is exactly as suspect as a missing one.

A single mutable template file filled in place across multiple provisioning attempts would reproduce the exact defect the README describes losing the att_34fd431f witness to.

self_check.note: Each is a statement this lane asserts about its OWN conduct. A certifier should treat any one of them as falsifiable.

required_independent_review.reason: This artifact re-derives ordering for a mandate whose literal word order the DAG's own preconditions contradict, allocates every field of a governing REQUIRED_CONTENTS list to a specific schema location, and makes a design choice (PV expected values as pointers, not transcriptions) the mandate does not explicitly settle. Each is a place a derivation could quietly omit a required field or misplace one required elsewhere, and none may be taken on this lane's word.
adversarial_questions_the_certifier_shou: Does every one of the 15 REQUIRED_CONTENTS items actually appear, as a hole, at the schema location FIELD_ALLOCATION_TABLE claims? Re-derive independently from the schema file rather than from this table.
Does the schema's additionalProperties:false discipline hold at EVERY object level, with no silent gap through which an unanticipated field, including a credential-shaped one, could pass validation?
Is OF-N07-1's DAG-precondition ordering the correct reading of 'must separate', or does the mandate require the literal listed order?

Does any const or enum value in the schema, when re-read against its cited DAG source, drift by even one word? DP7/DP8/DM28 in the DAG's own manifest exist because this repository has already measured that exact failure mode once.
Is the PV-1..PV-34 pointer design (OF-N07-2) a legitimate hole, or does REQUIRED_CONTENTS' 'each row with expected' require the 34 expected values transcribed now?
Does the template's must_never_contain_attestation.prohibited array match MUST_NEVER_CONTAIN's eight items byte-for-byte, by programmatic comparison?

Is the three-way rollback-statement set (ALTER ROLE ... NOLOGIN, no rollback for MR-2, REVOKE USAGE ...) exact and complete against MUTATION_ROLLBACK_CONTRACT, with no fourth statement invented and none softened?
what_a_certifier_may_NOT_do: It may NOT treat this artifact's structure as authority for any hosted act. No act is authorized by this artifact at any point.

It may NOT treat this artifact's existence as satisfying N05, N06, N08 or N09, each of which remains a distinct, open, unsatisfied node per the DAG amendment's own DOWNSTREAM_REACHABILITY_RECOMPUTATION.

It may NOT treat certification of this artifact as CLOSING N07 in the DAG package's own append-only lineage. That is a separate, later, governed act — the DAG package cannot be amended by a certification of a different package.
